fields.name: label
fields.label: Small label above the heading
fields.description: For example: PLAN BEFORE YOU APPLY

fields.name: inputs
fields.label: Tab 1 inputs (securities)
fields.description: One bulleted list, one bullet per type of security. In each bullet: the name in bold, then the LTV text with the percentage (for example LTV up to 80%), then the starting amount in italic (for example 10,00,000). The calculator reads the percentage from the LTV text, so keep it as a number followed by %.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Tab 1 result panel (sample figures)
fields.description: In this order: 1) a paragraph with the label, e.g. Your estimated eligible limit. 2) a paragraph with the sample limit in bold. 3) one bulleted list: first bullet = total portfolio value, then one bullet per security in the same order as the inputs. In each bullet: the label in bold, then the sample amount in italic. 4) a short note paragraph. The calculator replaces the sample amounts with the real result; with JavaScript off, visitors see these sample figures.

fields.name: cta
fields.label: Tab 1 button link
fields.description: A page address, or a section on this page such as #check-your-eligible-limit (include the #)

fields.name: ctaText
fields.label: Tab 1 button text
fields.description: For example: Apply for this limit

fields.name: inputs2
fields.label: Tab 2 inputs
fields.description: One bulleted list with exactly three bullets, in this order: the amount, the number of days, the interest rate. In each bullet: the name in bold, then the starting value in italic (for example 5,00,000 then 30 then 9.75).

fields.name: result2
fields.label: Tab 2 result panel (sample figures)
fields.description: In this order: 1) a paragraph with the label, e.g. Total interest for the period. 2) a paragraph with the sample interest in bold. 3) one bulleted list with three bullets: interest per day, average interest per month, principal. In each bullet: the label in bold, then the sample value in italic (the principal line is plain text and stays as written). 4) a short note paragraph.

fields.name: cta2
fields.label: Tab 2 button link
fields.description: A page address, or a section on this page such as #check-your-eligible-limit (include the #)

fields.name: noScriptNote
fields.label: Note shown only when JavaScript is off
fields.description: For example: Sample figures. Turn on JavaScript to enter your own amounts.
